title: Salesforce Security Architecture Masterclass (9 Lessons)
description:
Welcome to the Salesforce Security from Start to End playlist! 🚀

In this complete series, we’ll learn how Salesforce security works from the fundamentals all the way to advanced security concepts, with practical examples and real-world scenarios.

We’ll cover topics including:

🔐 Salesforce Security Model
👤 Profiles & Permission Sets
🏢 Organization-Wide Defaults (OWD)
📂 Role Hierarchy
🤝 Sharing Rules
👥 Manual Sharing & Teams
⚡ Apex Managed Sharing
🛡️ Field-Level Security (FLS)
📋 Object & Record-Level Security
🔑 Permission Set Groups
🚫 Restriction Rules
🔒 Login & Session Security
🌐 Network Access & Trusted IPs
🧩 Sharing Settings & Access Levels
💻 Apex Security and with sharing
🛠️ Security in Flows and Automation
🔍 Debugging & Troubleshooting Record Access
🎯 Real-world Security Scenarios
🏆 Best Practices for Designing a Secure Salesforce Org

Whether you're a Salesforce Admin, Developer, Consultant, Architect, or someone preparing for Salesforce certifications, this playlist is designed to build your understanding step by step.

By the end of this series, you should be able to confidently answer one of the most important Salesforce questions:

“Why can this user see or not see this record?” 🔥

📌 Subscribe and follow the complete playlist as we go from Salesforce Security Basics → Intermediate → Advanced → Real-World Scenarios.

title: Salesforce Administrator Complete Course (54 Lessons)
description:
🚀 Welcome to the Complete Salesforce Administrator Course (2026 Edition)!

If you're looking to learn Salesforce from scratch, you're in the right place. This course is designed for **absolute beginners** as well as professionals who want to build a strong foundation in Salesforce Administration.

In this course, you'll learn everything step by step with easy-to-understand explanations, real-world examples, and hands-on practical demonstrations inside a Salesforce Developer Org.

## 📚 What You'll Learn

✅ What is CRM & Why Salesforce CRM
✅ Salesforce Architecture & Navigation
✅ Standard & Custom Objects
✅ Fields & Field Data Types
✅ Records & Data Management
✅ Tabs & Apps
✅ Page Layouts & Record Types
✅ Relationships (Lookup & Master-Detail)
✅ Validation Rules & Formula Fields
✅ Security (Profiles, Roles, Permission Sets & Sharing)
✅ Reports & Dashboards
✅ Flow Builder & Business Automation
✅ Approval Processes
✅ Data Import & Data Loader
✅ Best Practices & Real-World Scenarios
✅ Salesforce Administrator Certification Preparation

🎯 By the end of this course, you'll be able to confidently work as a Salesforce Administrator, build business solutions, and prepare for Salesforce Admin interviews and certification.

Whether you're a student, job seeker, developer, administrator, or someone switching careers, this course will help you learn Salesforce from the ground up.
